Instructions for Use
Device description: The Rhea Coronary Stent System is a coronary stent. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 38 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Information
The Rhea Coronary Stent System is MR Conditional. A person with the Rhea Coronary Stent System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Rhea Coronary Stent System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3.0 T
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions B1+rms <= 1.5 uT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 0.1 W/kg
Scan Duration Limit total active scanning to 10 min.
Scan Regions Any landmark is acceptable
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
